reviews.comment: Probably my favorite class of the semester! We had 5 tests and two group projects. He goes over most of the material in class but you do have to do some independent reading on your own. As long as you show up and listen in class you should be okay! He's very passionate about history and he always made his lectures engaging.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Weber is a relatively OK professor. He makes class very fun and engaging, but you must read the assigned textbook called the American Yawp in his class. Your Average is mostly made up of tests. You'll do fine in his class if you do study the material and do note cards to help you for every exam taken in his class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures are straightforward and so are his quizzes. Theres no hidden or extra information that youll need to panic about. He gives simple assignments such as one to two page papers and some assignments to count for attendance. Easy A if you do all your work.

I am not interested in history but Professor Weber made this class so much fun. He is very energetic when teaching so his classes are never boring. The class is not difficult either as long as you attend class and turn in work on time. Easy A. I would definitely take this professor again.

One of the best Professors at the campus, his lectures are funny and pertinent to the topic, and it's hard to not be interested due to the way he covers topics. There is a few major essays in his classes, though if you ask he genuinely does try to help where he can in terms of feedback. Just be sure to show up to class, everything is in lecture.
